1: ## 1. Phase A — Investigation-first (Decision: Investigation-first with structured logging gate before any fix)
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 In `mcp/che-word-mcp/Sources/CheWordMCP/Server.swift`, add a private logger function `logDebug(event:keyValues:)` gated behind `CHE_WORD_MCP_LOG_LEVEL=debug` env var (read once at actor init). Emit one-line stderr format `[ISO8601] DEBUG <Event> key1=value1 key2=value2`. This satisfies "WordMCPServer logs structured diagnostics under CHE_WORD_MCP_LOG_LEVEL env var" requirement.
4: - [x] 1.2 [P] In `mcp/che-word-mcp/Tests/CheWordMCPTests/StructuredLoggingTests.swift`, write failing TDD tests for the logging requirement: (a) "Logging disabled by default" — capture stderr during `WordMCPServer()` + tool calls, assert no diagnostic lines; (b) "Debug logging captures handler entry/exit" — set `CHE_WORD_MCP_LOG_LEVEL=debug`, run insert_image_from_path against fixture, assert stderr contains expected line patterns. Run to confirm RED.
5: - [x] 1.3 In `Server.swift`, instrument the four sites listed in the spec requirement: `insertImageFromPath` entry/exit, `findBodyChildContainingText` entry, `storeDocument` entry/exit, `dispatchAutosaveCheckpoint` entry/exit. Verify task 1.2 tests turn GREEN.
6: - [x] 1.4 In `mcp/che-word-mcp/Tests/CheWordMCPTests/InsertCrashRegressionTests.swift`, write a smoke test `testThirdSequentialInsertImageDoesNotCrash` that loads an NTPU-style fixture (use `XCTSkip` fallback per `Tests/MacDocCLITests/NotePDFConvertTests.swift` precedent — fixture lives in `test-files/`, gitignored) and runs 3 sequential `insert_image_from_path` calls. If repro fails (no crash), document inline as "fixture insufficient for crash; ship Phases B+C without confirmed cause". If repro succeeds, capture `sample $MCP_PID` snapshot + Console.app crash report path; commit findings as inline comment in the test file.
7: - [~] 1.5 Local repro session (manual): set `CHE_WORD_MCP_LOG_LEVEL=debug`, attach to MCP process via test fixture, capture full stderr trace + crash artifacts. Document root cause hypothesis confirmed (or "no repro" outcome) in commit message for Phase B kickoff.
8:   - Skip reason: requires NTPU-style thesis fixture not present in this session (fixture is gitignored under `mcp/che-word-mcp/test-files/`). Per the SDD proposal Non-Goals — "Phase A may not yield repro: explicit non-goal to BLOCK Phases C/D on Phase A success" — Phases B/C/D ship regardless. The instrumentation infrastructure (Tasks 1.1–1.4) is shipped so any future session WITH the fixture can set `CHE_WORD_MCP_LOG_LEVEL=debug` and run `swift test --filter InsertCrashRegressionTests` to capture the trace.

10: ## 2. Phase B — rId allocator refactor + serial DocxReader (Decision: Kill `DocxReader.concurrentPerform`; serial-only OOXML IO policy with regression-as-test, Decision: Refactor `nextImageRelationshipId` (and `nextRelationshipId`) to consult original rels via `RelationshipIdAllocator`)
11: 
12: - [x] 2.1 In `packages/ooxml-swift/Tests/OOXMLSwiftTests/RelationshipIdAllocatorMutationTests.swift`, write failing TDD tests for "WordDocument mutation methods consult RelationshipIdAllocator instead of naive counter" requirement covering 3 spec scenarios: (a) reader-loaded thesis with rId1-rId24 returns rId25 on first insertImage; (b) sequential 3 inserts return rId25/rId26/rId27 with no collision; (c) initializer-built doc still allocates from rId4 baseline (no regression). Run to confirm RED.
13: - [x] 2.2 In `packages/ooxml-swift/Sources/OOXMLSwift/IO/RelationshipIdAllocator.swift`, expose the existing `init(originalRelsXML:additionalReservedIds:)` constructor for use by `WordDocument` (keep `internal final class` access; no public API change). Verify the allocator correctly seeds from typed-model collections (headers/footers/images/hyperlinks).
14: - [x] 2.3 In `packages/ooxml-swift/Sources/OOXMLSwift/Models/Document.swift`, add a private lazy property `_relationshipAllocator: RelationshipIdAllocator?` on `WordDocument`. Add internal accessor `getOrCreateAllocator()` that constructs the allocator on first call from `archiveTempDir` original rels XML (or empty XML for initializer-built docs) plus reserved IDs from current typed model state. Replace `nextImageRelationshipId` and `nextRelationshipId` call sites in `insertImage(base64:)`, `insertImage(path:)`, `insertImage(...at: InsertLocation)`, `addHeader`, `addFooter`, `addHyperlinkReference` with `getOrCreateAllocator().allocate()`. Verify task 2.1 tests turn GREEN.
15: - [x] 2.4 [P] In `packages/ooxml-swift/Tests/OOXMLSwiftTests/SerialOnlyOOXMLTests.swift`, write failing TDD test `testNoParallelPrimitivesInOOXMLIO` that runs `grep -rnE 'concurrentPerform|withTaskGroup|withThrowingTaskGroup|DispatchQueue\\.global|DispatchQueue\\..*\\.async|Task\\.detached' packages/ooxml-swift/Sources/OOXMLSwift/IO/` and asserts zero matches. Run to confirm RED (current `DocxReader.swift:456` triggers the match).
16: - [x] 2.5 In `packages/ooxml-swift/Sources/OOXMLSwift/IO/DocxReader.swift` lines 438-499, remove the parallel chunk-parsing block. Replace with a serial loop preserving per-chunk aggregation (or simplify to single-pass parsing — choose the cleaner shape during impl). Keep error capture but remove the `errorLock` since serialized execution makes it unnecessary. Verify task 2.4 test turns GREEN. This satisfies "ooxml-swift IO layer is fully serial; parallel primitives forbidden" requirement.
17: - [x] 2.6 [P] Add `packages/ooxml-swift/Tests/OOXMLSwiftTests/DocxReaderDeterminismTests.swift` test asserting `DocxReader.read(from: fixture)` produces identical `body.children.count` and per-paragraph text content across 5 invocations against the same source bytes. Confirms parsing determinism prerequisite for `recover_from_autosave`.
18: - [x] 2.7 Verify all `swift test` pass in ooxml-swift (expect 397 baseline + 5+ new = 402 minimum). Update `packages/ooxml-swift/CHANGELOG.md` with v0.13.3 entry citing closes che-word-mcp#41 root cause + serial-only policy. Commit, push, `git tag v0.13.3`, `git push --tags`, `gh release create v0.13.3` with detailed notes citing both rId allocator + serial DocxReader changes.
19: 
20: ## 3. Phase C — Autosave Design B (Decision: Autosave Design A → Design B; default `autosave_every: 0 → 1`)
21: 
22: - [x] 3.1 In `mcp/che-word-mcp/Tests/CheWordMCPTests/AutosaveDesignBTests.swift`, write failing TDD tests for the MODIFIED "open_document supports autosave_every for periodic checkpoint" requirement covering all 4 scenarios from the spec: (a) default autosave_every preserves prior mutations on crash mid-batch (simulate crash via injected throw in mutating handler); (b) autosave fires before every Nth mutation (N=3, 7 mutations, verify counter trajectory matches example); (c) autosave_every: 0 disables autosave entirely; (d) successful save_document cleans up .autosave.docx + resets counter. Run to confirm RED against current Design A implementation.
23: - [x] 3.2 In `mcp/che-word-mcp/Sources/CheWordMCP/Server.swift`, extract `dispatchAutosaveCheckpointIfDue(docId:)` private helper. The helper SHALL check `autosaveCounter[docId] > 0 && counter % autosaveEvery[docId] == 0`, and when true write current `openDocuments[docId]` to `<sourcePath>.autosave.docx` via `DocxWriter.write` synchronously. Move counter increment from `storeDocument` to AFTER mutation success (Design B: increment-after-success preserves "counter == number of successful mutations").
24: - [x] 3.3 In `Server.swift`, invoke `dispatchAutosaveCheckpointIfDue(docId:)` at the START of every mutating handler that calls `storeDocument` (audit list: `insertImageFromPath`, `insertImage`, `insertParagraph`, `replaceText`, `replaceTextBatch`, `addHeader`, `addFooter`, plus all editing tools that go through `storeDocument`). Add the call right after `guard var doc = openDocuments[docId]` but before the actual mutation logic.
25: - [x] 3.4 In `Server.swift` `open_document` tool registration, change the `autosave_every` parameter description to document default value `1` (was `0` in v3.6.0). In the handler `openDocument(args:)`, change `let autosaveEveryN = args["autosave_every"]?.intValue ?? 0` to `?? 1`. Verify task 3.1 tests turn GREEN.
26: - [x] 3.5 In `Server.swift` `saveDocument` and `finalizeDocument` handlers, after successful `persistDocumentToDisk` + autosave file cleanup, reset `autosaveCounter[docId] = 0`. Confirms the "Successful save_document cleans up .autosave.docx" scenario's counter-reset clause.
27: - [x] 3.6 [P] Update `mcp/che-word-mcp/README.md` and `README_zh-TW.md`: replace the v3.6.0 autosave description with Design B semantics + default flip + explicit warning that callers wanting zero autosave overhead must pass `autosave_every: 0`. Add a "Migration from v3.6.0" subsection in version history explaining the default change.

35: - [x] 4.5 Bump `psychquant-claude-plugins/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` and `plugins/che-word-mcp/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` to 3.7.0; commit + push; `claude plugin marketplace update psychquant-claude-plugins`; `claude plugin update che-word-mcp@psychquant-claude-plugins`.
36: - [x] 4.6 Run `/idd-close #40` (autosave) and `/idd-close #41` (insert crash) sequentially with comprehensive closing summaries citing the Decisions, root causes (per Phase A findings or "investigation inconclusive, fix shipped"), and verification (ooxml-swift 402+ tests, che-word-mcp 93+N tests).
37: - [x] 4.7 Run `/spectra-archive che-word-mcp-insert-crash-autosave-fix` to archive the SDD; verify spec sync applied MODIFIED requirements to live `openspec/specs/che-word-mcp-session-state-api/spec.md` and ADDED requirements to `openspec/specs/ooxml-content-insertion-primitives/spec.md`.
